parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61012.htm) to query available regions. Use this parameter to specify the region in which to create the instance
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61012.htm)查询，使用此参数指定要创建实例的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace instance. You can call DescribeInstances (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/redis/developer-reference/api-r-kvstore-2015-01-01-describeinstances-redis) to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: Workspace的实例 ID，可调用 DescribeInstances (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/redis/developer-reference/api-r-kvstore-2015-01-01-describeinstances-redis) 获取
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The table name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character. The name cannot contain the following characters: @/:="<>{}[] or spaces
parameters.help_zh: 表名称。 名称为2-128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，不支持字符@/:="<>{}[]和空格
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The instance type. Set the value to tair_skv_ddb_table
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
To create an instance from a backup set of an existing instance, specify the source instance ID in this parameter.

This parameter must be used together with BackupId
parameters.help_zh:
如需基于某个实例的备份集创建新实例，请先在此参数中指定源实例 ID。

说明

本参数需要BackupId与组合使用
parameters.name: src_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster backup set ID. Some new cluster architectures support this parameter. You can call DescribeClusterBackupList (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/redis/developer-reference/api-r-kvstore-2015-01-01-describeclusterbackuplist-redis) to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 部分新集群架构支持集群备份集 ID，您可以通过 DescribeClusterBackupList (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/redis/developer-reference/api-r-kvstore-2015-01-01-describeclusterbackuplist-redis) 接口获取
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The table schema configuration in JSON format
parameters.help_zh: JSON形式的表结构配置信息
parameters.name: schema

parameters.help_en: The parameter settings switch in JSON format
parameters.name: ttl_spec

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go

付费类型，返回值：

ConnectionDomain.description_en: The internal endpoint of the Redis instance
